project_idea.project_name: 九澳水库扩容建造工程
project_idea.owner_intent: 市政与公共基础设施；库容由34万增至74万立方米；九澳水库扩容建造工程
constraints: DBB; scope and budget changes require macro approval

owner_requirements.project_scope: 九澳水库扩容建造工程为市政与公共基础设施项目，目标将库容由34万立方米增至74万立方米，采用DBB交付模式，总预算MOP 150,000,000，工期24个月。本包为施工包「主坝与库盆土建工程包」的材料供应包，仅负责供货、运输到场、质量证明文件及质保期内更换，不含施工、安装、临时工程或措施费，不承担施工界面责任。材料费用已含于施工合同价MOP 60,710,000内，由施工包承包商作为买方支付，本包预算为MOP 17,850,000。
functional_requirements: 按施工包「主坝与库盆土建工程包」的材料与构配件需求，提供符合设计文件与规范要求的供货、运输到场、质量证明文件和质保期内更换服务。
材料供应需配合主坝加高加固、库盆开挖与整形、围堰与施工导流、永久结构混凝土、坝基处理及与防渗包交接面土建收面的施工顺序，提供分批供货节点建议。
提供材料技术规格与设计文件对应清单，明确关键材料由哪版图纸和规范控制，作为评标技术符合性判断依据。
提供到场材料质量证明文件清单与验收标准，作为独立检查与验收的基础。
提供质保期内更换责任方案，明确响应时限与更换流程。
提供材料包装、运输与现场交付的物流方案，满足澳门市区至九澳水库工地的运输条件。
technical_requirements: 材料技术规格须与主坝加高、库盆整形和坝基处理的设计图纸及规范对齐，由设计协调部锁定对应版本。
供货方案需包含分批交付节点框架，与围堰、导流和坝基处理的施工关键路径衔接。
质量证明文件须覆盖材料出厂检验、第三方检测及到场验收记录，满足独立检查要求。
材料耐久性目标须满足水库长期运行环境， maintainability目标须便于后期维护与更换。
供应商须提供材料与施工安装接口信息，供承包商协调安装界面。
能源使用目标须符合项目可持续发展要求，优先考虑低碳材料与运输方案。
业主验收路径须明确材料到场验收、质量文件审核与质保期更换的确认流程。
owner_requirements.budget_policy: 本包预算为MOP 17,850,000，已含于施工合同价MOP 60,710,000内，由得宝国际作为买方支付。鉴于材料价格指数为1.112且工期24个月，业主期望投标报价明确单价固定或调价机制，包括调价触发条件与依据指数，以控制材料涨价风险。评标时业主将比较报价基础说明与分项报价，判断价格合理性与风险分担的清晰度。
owner_requirements.schedule_policy: 工期24个月，材料供应须配合施工包关键路径。业主期望投标人提交分批供货节点框架与到场验收要求，明确与围堰、导流和坝基处理的衔接时间。评标时将比较供货计划的现实性、业主审核时间、包间接口时间及公共通道协调时间，判断交付信心。
compliance_requirements: 业主审核节奏：材料技术规格与设计文件对应清单须经设计协调部确认后方可发出招标文件。
问题升级路径：报价基础与调价机制争议须提交项目总监与商务经理共同决策。
文档纪律：质量证明文件清单与验收标准列为强制提交项，缺失者视为不响应。
接口签署：材料技术规格接口由设计协调经理签署确认，供货节点接口由施工经理签署确认。
公共通道协调：运输路线与到场时间须与公共通道管理要求协调。
质量目标跟踪：到场材料验收合格率与质保更换响应时限纳入跟踪。
安全期望跟踪：运输与交付过程的安全要求纳入供应商履约跟踪。
变更控制纪律：材料规格或供货节点变更须经业主变更控制流程批准。
risk_priorities: 价格锁定风险：材料价格指数1.112，开口价将直接侵蚀施工包利润，须优先澄清固定单价或调价机制。
供货延误风险：材料到场节奏未能配合围堰、导流和坝基处理，将拖累施工关键路径。
质量证明风险：质量证明文件清单与验收标准不明确，将导致独立检查缺乏依据与返工责任转嫁。
规格接口风险：材料技术规格未与设计文件版本锁定，将削弱技术符合性判断与土建包质量记录。
预算对应风险：材料包预算与施工合同价内材料费的对应关系须核对一致。

本投标不承诺24个月固定单价。分项单价以材料价格指数1.112为基准价编制，调价触发条件为：结算期公布的材料价格指数相对基准指数变动超过正负3%时，超出部分按分项材料权重调整；依据指数为项目适用的材料价格指数，权重与指数来源在合同附件中书面锁定。运输与质保更换分项按草案成本列示，运输单价在合同期内固定。

**与施工合同价内材料费的对应关系**
本包材料费已包含在施工包合同价内，由施工承包商作为买方支付。本报价MOP 17,850,000与包预算上限对应，按材料本体、运输到场、质保更换三项可核对拆分，便于承包商核对其施工合同价内材料费构成。

**付款评审路径与付款节点**
付款方为施工承包商。付款节点按到场验收合格并提交完整质量证明文件后计量，按月对账；付款评审路径在投标文件中书面明确为：到场验收单与质量文件包齐备、承包商计量确认、按合同约定账期支付。

**到场验收**
到场验收要求作为供货承诺的书面依据，质量证明文件不齐的批次不交付验收。

**须披露的假设**
团队可用性摘要、分批供货节点框架与调价口径均未在情景记录中锁定，按已披露假设编制，并据此设定价格与风险边界。
bid_documents.risk_response:
**材料涨价风险**
材料价格指数已达1.112，24个月固定单价风险过高。应对：分项单价加明确调价触发条件（正负3%阈值）与依据指数，超出阈值部分按权重调整；同时在报价内保留MOP 610,000的有限风险准备金覆盖阈值内敞口与指数联动滞后。不承诺固定单价，也不设无限敞口。

**供货延误风险**
应对：按承包商书面供货计划滚动排产并预留提前期；关键材料设置备选货源（属计划，尚未取得供应商书面承诺）；分批到场降低单点延误影响；延误事件按合同约定书面通报并提交赶工方案。

**质量证明文件不齐风险**
应对：编制与独立复核分离，文件包随货提交，不齐批次不交付验收。

**团队可用性未锁定风险**
情景记录未提供具名人员或团队可用性摘要，按已披露假设处理，并在报价内计入组织不确定性对应的商务调整；资源账上本包占用0.25、可用2.0，总量有余量。

**付款方为承包商的风险**
应对：付款评审路径与付款节点书面化，按到场验收与文件齐备计量，按月对账。

**界面风险**
本包不含施工、安装与界面责任，安装接口信息以书面交付承包商，界面责任不进入本包报价。

1. 季度调价封顶：材料单价以材料价格指数1.112为基准，仅当指数单季偏离基准超过正负5%时启动调价；每季度调价幅度上限为正负3%，累计调价幅度上限为正负8%；超出上述上限的部分由供应商COMP-0191承担，买方不予补偿。指数来源须在签约时书面指定为双方认可的公开指数并注明发布机构与取值口径。
2. 风险准备金与调价机制的关系：MOP 610,000材料涨价风险准备金仅覆盖调价触发前的指数上行敞口，不得与季度调价重复计取；准备金动用须凭指数取值记录书面结算。
3. 付款节点与逾期处理（我方作为买方的自身立场，现予明确并写入）：按每批到场验收合格并提交合格证、检验报告与可追溯批号后30日内支付该批货款的80%，余款20%于质保期届满且无未决质量争议后支付；逾期付款按合同约定利率计息。验收放行不以付款为前置条件，付款亦不以超出上述文件之外的额外条件为前置。
4. 规格接口前置：材料族规格参数表与产品适配说明的提交时点由签约后1至2个月提前至签约后14日内提交，并由我方设计协调部完成一次接口核对后，方可锁定分批到场节点框架。
5. 分项报价与预算内材料费对应关系：请供应商在修订稿中列明各分项中固定与随指数浮动的划分，以对应施工包合同价内材料费。

上述第1至4项为签约条件；第5项为签约前须补齐的书面说明。若修订稿完整纳入第1至4项，我方即可按该修订稿接受。

negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: Scope remains exactly the supply package CASE-0003/supply-1: supply, transport to site, quality certification documents and warranty-period replacement of materials and components for the main dam and reservoir basin civil works package; no construction, installation, temporary works, measure costs or construction interface responsibility; material cost is included in the parent construction package CASE-0003/construction-1 contract price and paid by COMP-0025 as buyer. COMP-0191 shall submit material-family specification parameter tables and product fit statements within 14 days after signing; COMP-0025 design coordination department shall complete one interface check within 14 days after receipt, and only then shall the batch arrival node framework be locked. Installation interface information is provided by COMP-0191 in writing only, with no interface responsibility. Each batch shall be accompanied by certificate of conformity, inspection report and traceable batch number; release for use only after on-site acceptance; no supply-first-document-later. Quality review includes an independent check step with two-way verification of document and physical batch numbers.
negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: Total price remains MOP 17,850,000 with unchanged work shares and resource commitments. Material unit prices use material price index 1.112 as base; quarterly adjustment is triggered only when the index deviates from base by more than plus or minus 5% in a single quarter; each quarterly adjustment is capped at plus or minus 3%; cumulative adjustment is capped at plus or minus 8%; any excess beyond these caps is borne by COMP-0191 and not compensated by COMP-0025. The index source shall be a publicly recognized index jointly agreed and specified in writing at signing, with publishing institution and valuation basis stated. The MOP 610,000 material price risk reserve covers only index upward exposure before the adjustment trigger and shall not be counted twice with quarterly adjustment; use of the reserve requires written settlement supported by index valuation records. COMP-0191 shall list in the revised contract the split of fixed versus index-floating portions within each quotation line item to correspond to the material cost within the construction contract price; this written statement is to be completed before signing. No uncapped price adjustment is added.
negotiated_clauses.payment_terms: For each batch, within 30 days after on-site acceptance and submission of certificate of conformity, inspection report and traceable batch number, COMP-0025 shall pay 80% of that batch price; the remaining 20% shall be paid after expiry of the warranty period and resolution of no outstanding quality dispute. Late payment bears interest at the contract-agreed rate. Acceptance and release are not conditional on payment, and payment is not conditional on any additional conditions beyond the stated documents. If payment is overdue by more than 60 days, COMP-0191 may suspend subsequent batch supply without liability for delay.
negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: Supply period is 24 months aligned with the construction package schedule. The batch arrival node framework shall be confirmed with COMP-0025 within 1 to 2 months after signing, subject to the prior completion of the 14-day specification submission and interface check. Key materials are locked in advance with inventory buffer and alternative sources implemented during supply preparation. Transport routes and on-site unloading conditions are confirmed in writing; unloading and on-site secondary handling remain within the construction package. Warranty replacement follows the four-step closed loop of written application, cause determination, replacement delivery and re-inspection confirmation, with response times committed according to deliverable capability. COMP-0025 accepts progress review, quality document review and on-site acceptance; COMP-0191 accepts the same.
negotiated_clauses.response_to_feedback: Buyer COMP-0025 decides and writes into the contract: quarterly index adjustment caps of plus or minus 5% trigger, plus or minus 3% per quarter and plus or minus 8% cumulative, with excess borne by COMP-0191; the MOP 610,000 reserve is non-duplicative and settled in writing against index records; payment of 80% within 30 days after batch acceptance and documents, 20% after warranty expiry without unresolved quality dispute, late interest at contract rate, and no payment precondition beyond stated documents; specification tables and product fit statements within 14 days after signing followed by one buyer interface check before locking batch nodes; and a pre-signing written split of fixed versus index-floating amounts by line item. Supplier COMP-0191 feedback is incorporated as binding obligations: payment within 30 days after batch acceptance, late interest, and suspension right after 60 days overdue without delay liability; quarterly adjustment of undelivered batch material cost when index deviates more than 5% from base, calculated solely from the contract-specified index source; and the quality release sequence with independent two-way batch-number verification. Bidder assumptions on buyer payment credit verification, budget material-cost correspondence and batch node framework are accepted as stated risk allocations, with the budget correspondence to be completed in writing before signing. No external documents are claimed reviewed and no real-world approvals are claimed obtained. All future engineering deliverables are binding obligations, not completed facts. bid_document.technical_proposal:
本投标以单一供应商身份承担主坝与库盆土建工程包的材料与构配件供货责任，范围严格限定为供货、运输到场、质量证明文件与质保期内更换，不含任何施工、安装、临时工程或措施费，亦不承担施工界面责任。

**材料适配与规格响应**：按施工包工作内容（主坝加高加固、库盆开挖整形、围堰与导流、永久结构混凝土、坝基处理及与防渗包交接面土建收面）梳理材料族：水泥及掺合料、骨料与级配碎石、钢筋与预应力材料、模板与支撑构配件、止水与接缝辅材（不含防渗膜与止水系统本体）、坝基处理用灌浆与土工材料。每族材料提交规格参数表与产品适配说明，供承包商核对设计规格。

**供货协调与分批交付**：按施工包进度编制分批到场节点框架，设常备库存缓冲与备选货源，关键材料提前锁量。运输路线与到场卸货条件以书面说明交承包商，卸货与场内二次搬运属施工包范围。

**安装接口信息**：仅以书面说明向承包商提供材料安装接口信息，不承担界面责任。

**团队可用性摘要**：本包资源占用0.25，公司可用资源2.0，供货期24个月资源可支撑；配置供应链主管、质量合规经理、商务经理与交付负责人各一名，按分批节点投入。

negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: Scope remains exactly the supply package CASE-0003/supply-1: supply, transport to site, quality certification documents and warranty-period replacement of materials and components for the main dam and reservoir basin civil works package; no construction, installation, temporary works, measure costs or construction interface responsibility; material cost is included in the parent construction package CASE-0003/construction-1 contract price and paid by COMP-0025 as buyer. COMP-0191 shall submit material-family specification parameter tables and product fit statements within 14 days after signing; COMP-0025 design coordination department shall complete one interface check within 14 days after receipt, and only then shall the batch arrival node framework be locked. Installation interface information is provided by COMP-0191 in writing only, with no interface responsibility. Each batch shall be accompanied by certificate of conformity, inspection report and traceable batch number; release for use only after on-site acceptance; no supply-first-document-later. Quality review includes an independent check step with two-way verification of document and physical batch numbers.
negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: Total price remains MOP 17,850,000 with unchanged work shares and resource commitments. Material unit prices use material price index 1.112 as base; quarterly adjustment is triggered only when the index deviates from base by more than plus or minus 5% in a single quarter; each quarterly adjustment is capped at plus or minus 3%; cumulative adjustment is capped at plus or minus 8%; any excess beyond these caps is borne by COMP-0191 and not compensated by COMP-0025. The index source shall be a publicly recognized index jointly agreed and specified in writing at signing, with publishing institution and valuation basis stated. The MOP 610,000 material price risk reserve covers only index upward exposure before the adjustment trigger and shall not be counted twice with quarterly adjustment; use of the reserve requires written settlement supported by index valuation records. COMP-0191 shall list in the revised contract the split of fixed versus index-floating portions within each quotation line item to correspond to the material cost within the construction contract price; this written statement is to be completed before signing. No uncapped price adjustment is added.
negotiated_clauses.payment_terms: For each batch, within 30 days after on-site acceptance and submission of certificate of conformity, inspection report and traceable batch number, COMP-0025 shall pay 80% of that batch price; the remaining 20% shall be paid after expiry of the warranty period and resolution of no outstanding quality dispute. Late payment bears interest at the contract-agreed rate. Acceptance and release are not conditional on payment, and payment is not conditional on any additional conditions beyond the stated documents. If payment is overdue by more than 60 days, COMP-0191 may suspend subsequent batch supply without liability for delay.
negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: Supply period is 24 months aligned with the construction package schedule. The batch arrival node framework shall be confirmed with COMP-0025 within 1 to 2 months after signing, subject to the prior completion of the 14-day specification submission and interface check. Key materials are locked in advance with inventory buffer and alternative sources implemented during supply preparation. Transport routes and on-site unloading conditions are confirmed in writing; unloading and on-site secondary handling remain within the construction package. Warranty replacement follows the four-step closed loop of written application, cause determination, replacement delivery and re-inspection confirmation, with response times committed according to deliverable capability. COMP-0025 accepts progress review, quality document review and on-site acceptance; COMP-0191 accepts the same.
negotiated_clauses.response_to_feedback: Buyer COMP-0025 decides and writes into the contract: quarterly index adjustment caps of plus or minus 5% trigger, plus or minus 3% per quarter and plus or minus 8% cumulative, with excess borne by COMP-0191; the MOP 610,000 reserve is non-duplicative and settled in writing against index records; payment of 80% within 30 days after batch acceptance and documents, 20% after warranty expiry without unresolved quality dispute, late interest at contract rate, and no payment precondition beyond stated documents; specification tables and product fit statements within 14 days after signing followed by one buyer interface check before locking batch nodes; and a pre-signing written split of fixed versus index-floating amounts by line item. Supplier COMP-0191 feedback is incorporated as binding obligations: payment within 30 days after batch acceptance, late interest, and suspension right after 60 days overdue without delay liability; quarterly adjustment of undelivered batch material cost when index deviates more than 5% from base, calculated solely from the contract-specified index source; and the quality release sequence with independent two-way batch-number verification. Bidder assumptions on buyer payment credit verification, budget material-cost correspondence and batch node framework are accepted as stated risk allocations, with the budget correspondence to be completed in writing before signing. No external documents are claimed reviewed and no real-world approvals are claimed obtained. All future engineering deliverables are binding obligations, not completed facts. Price, currency, scope boundaries, parties, work shares and resource commitments are unchanged; no uncapped price adjustment is added. Each party remains free to reject this draft.
